_comment: Copy to <root>/tools/<slug>.run.json. This one file drives both workflows and the control room. Keys: references/run-config.md.
brief: The owner's or client's request, verbatim.
context:
Acme Clinic is a clinic management product on Frappe v16 + ERPNext v16 + Frappe Healthcare v16, with our app acme_clinic and a Vue 3 + frappe-ui staff app at /clinic.
WHAT EXISTS (reuse, do not redo): reception, doctor and lab screens; branding settings; three print formats; the demo e2e spec (qa/e2e/demo.spec.ts).
The client: a two-branch clinic. Demo data is invented.
environment:
- Local bench in Docker: site clinic.localhost, http://localhost:8000; staff app /clinic; Desk /desk. Demo users share the password in env var DEMO_PASSWORD (env/.demo.env): read it from the environment, never print it.
- App source on the host: <root>/app/ (bind-mounted at /workspace/app). Edit with file tools on the host.
- Bench commands ONLY through the locked wrapper: "<root>/env/benchl" --site clinic.localhost <cmd>.
- Frontend build: docker compose -f "<root>/env/compose.yml" exec -T -w /workspace/app/frontend bench flock /tmp/yarn.lock yarn build. yarn/npx only inside the container.
- Python reloads by itself; DocType JSON / custom fields / print formats need migrate (via benchl).
- Browser checks: Playwright from <root>/qa/e2e/ on the host.
rules: Keep the existing demo spec passing.

research.title: Pharmacy rules the clinic must follow
research.task: Dispensing, batch and expiry, controlled-drug registers and billing rules for a small clinic pharmacy in the client's country; cite the regulations.

research.title: What ERPNext and Healthcare already give us
research.task: Map the doctypes, hooks and reports that cover dispensing and stock; cite file paths.

pm.desc: Project Manager: you lead the project, write the requirements, the plan and the report.

ceo.label: CEO
ceo.name: CEO
ceo.desc: CEO: you think from the customer's and the business's point of view; you decide scope and sign off the demo.

ver.label: Verifier
ver.name: Verifier
ver.desc: Adversarial verifier: you try to refute claims and break the build; you fix confirmed defects in documents.

res.label: Research
res.name: Researchers
res.desc: Research sub-agent working for the project manager.

fdev.label: Senior Frappe dev
fdev.name: Senior Frappe Developer
fdev.desc: Senior Frappe developer (fdev): expert in Frappe v16, ERPNext and Healthcare internals. You own doctypes, custom fields, roles, hooks.py and the domain APIs (plan §9).

sdev.label: Senior dev
sdev.name: Senior Developer
sdev.desc: Senior developer (sdev): you own the session and billing APIs, print helpers, overrides and security probes (plan §9).

fe1.label: Frontend 1
fe1.name: Frontend 1
fe1.desc: Frontend developer 1 (fe1): Vue 3 + frappe-ui SPA in app/frontend. You own the screens plan §9 gives you.

ux.label: UI/UX
ux.name: UI/UX Designer
ux.desc: UI/UX designer (ux): you own the design files, print HTML/CSS and fonts. You design from the users' side: neat, calm, professional, status colours with text labels.

seed.label: Demo data
seed.name: Demo Data
seed.desc: Demo data owner (seed): you own the seed, the reset script, the clean backup, the e2e spec and the gate runs. Only you may reset the system.
